Waterford Star 1915 nov 9

Mr. Joseph Casey, son of Mr. M. J. Casey, U.D., has received a commission in the Army Service Corps. This young man, who is of a fine athletic build, is but 18 years of age. He has now joined the colours for training. He is most popular with all his associates who wish all kinds of good luck to his career. He was educated at the Christian Brothers and Mount Melleray.
